Uncloud v0.4.39 improves navigation on connected devices and adds image enlargement inside the app. The same changes ship to Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon and Linux x64.

- Mobile navigation stays above the workspace when a conversation starts. The sidebar, Back, Forward and Notifications remain reachable, with workspace actions on a separate row. The app, navigation drawer and image viewer follow the visible browser viewport when the keyboard resizes or pans it.
- Click or tap an image in Outputs, Image Generate, Image Edit, Product Studio or generated Chat replies to open it inside Uncloud. The viewer includes fit, zoom, scrolling, download and close controls, keyboard focus handling and Escape to close. Leaving a workspace also closes its viewer.
- Chat shows the selected model name in the header. Desktop and connected-browser requests retain the same native messages, controls and tool schemas. No identity correction, date, provider persona or new tool instructions are added.
- Browser pages and API responses use a no-store cache policy so a reload obtains the current app and model state. Authentication and paired-device session requirements remain in force.

Verification: 1,298 backend tests passed (12 optional tests skipped), all 247 UI tests passed, and the production web build passed. Browser checks covered desktop, 390-pixel and 320-pixel layouts, starting a chat, switching sections, returning to the retained conversation, and opening, zooming and closing an image. These layout checks used synthetic local fixtures; physical phone keyboards and Windows/Linux inference were not tested locally. A generic model reply such as “AI assistant” is not proof of a different loaded model, and no specific identity wording is forced.
